**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 11.1 is the sole renewal mechanic. It provides automatic **one-year** renewals (not multi-year), exitable by either party — including us — on **30 days'** written notice before the end of the initial term or any renewal term. That notice window is inside both the preferred (30-day) and fallback (60-day) ceilings, and the 12-month renewal length matches the preferred position.

No provision permits a renewal price uplift: Exhibit B fixes Licence, MarketSite.net Access and Maintenance and Support fees for "Year 2-5, and beyond," and Section 4.2's evergreen maintenance continuation is expressly at those Exhibit B fees. The conditional price-cap elements (3% preferred / 5% fallback) are therefore not engaged.

The only shortfall against preferred is the absence of a Commerce One reminder 60 days before renewal — a minor reminder mechanic that per the playbook is noted, not redlined. We would raise it only as a nice-to-have in negotiation.
